laws.rule: Triglav National Park: camping, tenting and overnight stays only at designated places (campsites, huts); no wild camping. Fires are banned in the natural environment except at specially arranged sites.
laws.heading: Triglav National Park

laws.rule: Triglav National Park: no driving, stopping or parking motor vehicles in the natural environment, and no cycling off the routes the park allows. Dogs must be on a lead in the natural environment.
laws.heading: Triglav National Park

laws.rule: Triglav National Park: no swimming in high-mountain lakes and streams, for people or dogs.
laws.heading: Triglav National Park

laws.rule: Triglav National Park: mushrooms (up to 2 kg) and forest fruits may be picked only in the third protection zone.
laws.heading: Triglav National Park
